author: voidloop
body:
Hello!

Yesterday, I was playing on quintus with my friend BrightSoul__, when all of the sudden my connection drops for like 3 seconds. Then I log back onto avicus, get on the map, continue playing for about 3-5 minutes and then Dilpickel says: I saw that.

So, I didn't know what he was talking about, so i just continued playing.

5 minutes later I get Temp banned for Combat Logging, which I found pretty Interesting & Annoying since My connection dropped for like 3 seconds. 

Even my friend BrightSoul__ had a Voice recording of me seconds before my connection dropped, but, he erraced it, since we both thought It woudn't be crucial.


Also, I've got past Infractions of Combat Logging, And I know 20 infractions is a Permaban, and I'm in a Really good team and a really good situation, so I wouldn't be stupid enough to Combat log and get 1 infraction more.

Also, I'd like to see some Ban proof, Is there any footage in this ban?

Hello.

The evidence of you combat logging is right there. As Sessp said, there is no way you timed out and re-joined in that short time period. This appeal is denied.
